test_results.name: G1.6-A: validateTargetUrlAndResolve attaches pinnedIp and pinnedFamily to URL
G1.6-A: pinnedLookup binds socket resolution strictly to pinned IP without re-querying
G1.6-A: Pinned fetch connects directly to pinned IP and preserves Host header and SNI
G1.6-A: Dynamic DNS Rebinding Attack is neutralized by transport-level IP pinning
G1.6-A: DNS resolution returning Cloud Metadata (169.254.169.254) is blocked immediately
G1.6-A: Mixed DNS response (public IP + forbidden private IP) is strictly rejected fail-closed
G1.6-A: DNS resolution returning empty records or ENOTFOUND throws explicit SSRF violation
G1.6-A: HTTP 3xx redirect is rejected by transport without opening second connection
G1.6-A: IPv4-mapped IPv6 and link-local representations are rejected
G1.6-A: Production allowlist and allowedGateways enforce DNS resolution and IP pinning with real transport
G1.6-A: Gateway in allowedGateways resolving to metadata IP is blocked under allowCustomGateway: false
G1.6-A: Public IP literal is rejected when allowCustomGateway is false
G1.6-A: IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses (metadata & loopback) are rejected
G1.6-A: NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96) and 6to4 (2002::/16) embedding metadata are rejected
G1.6-A: Non-canonical IPv6 strings and RFC 6890 reserved ranges are rejected
G1.6-A: Multiple trailing dots cannot bypass loopback or allowlist filters
G1.6-B: PolicyEngine resolveTimeoutMs defaults to DEFAULT_INFERENCE_TIMEOUT_MS (60,000ms)
G1.6-B: parseTimeoutMs handles 0, negative and invalid values by returning undefined (triggering fallback)
G1.6-B: ObservableLlmProviderAdapter enforces defaultTimeoutMs when input.timeoutMs is omitted
G1.6-C: normalizeRetryCount parses valid numeric strings, numbers, and clamps negatives
G1.6-C: PolicyEngine retriesFor respects numeric string in contract YAML
